hooks.name: Pre-tool guard (scope, secrets, Working style, external actions)
hooks.description: Enforces RAHN loop guardrails: only files listed for the current task may change; .env is never read or written; API-key-like content is blocked; the README Working style section cannot be AI-edited; git add/commit/push cannot include .env; push/gh/web calls require human approval; writes lock after loop escalation.
